summary: Approved. The mechanical regularity is gone: the right arm now trails the left by 2 frames, the shins trail the thighs, and the feet point and relax after each knee (Foot.rx 16-34, opposite on the two sides). Metrics report 0 twinned channels, 0 lockstep frames, overlap 1.0 and no pops. Re-checked on the rig at iteration 2: the scull is still symmetric in shape (hands at x +2.78/-2.70 on F000, about +1.9/-1.8 on F015), no parts intersect on any frame and the seam is closed. Sheets F000-F060 read as treading water: hands scull in and out, knees circle, body bobs. One low polish item remains.

findings.observation: Head.rx is a flat -12 for all 60 frames (curves.png); only the slow 10 deg turn on ry moves the head, so it does not react to the bob. A 2-3 deg nod trailing the bob would add life, but it is not visible at game distance.
